Рекомендуем трубочку заполнять пластилин: We recommend filling the tube with plasticine sequentially. Use a nail to tightly pack the plasticine without air gaps inside.
С помощью шланга вы можете заполнять тру: Using the hose, you can fill the tube with water by sucking it through the hose with your mouth; after filling the tube with water, close the hose with the clamp. To remove the float, you can blow it out into a glass along with the water.
Тонкую пластиковую трубочку, которая слу: The thin plastic tube serving as the float must be partially filled with plasticine using a small nail. Most of the plasticine should be on one side; the other side is simply closed with plasticine. The total length of the plasticine column is the sum of the lengths on each side. In the tube, the float should be positioned so that its center of mass is below the middle of the tube.
